covers: The two forms of the 8255 control word

entries.name: mode set
entries.description: Sets the direction of every port and the mode of both groups.
entries.behaviour: Bit 0 makes PC0 to PC3 inputs, bit 1 port B an input, bit 2 selects group B mode 1, bit 3 makes PC4 to PC7 inputs, bit 4 port A an input; a clear bit means output or mode 0. Bits 6 and 5 select group A mode 0, 1 or 2 (2 and 3 mean mode 2).

entries.name: port C bit set/reset
entries.description: Sets or clears one bit of port C, or a handshake flag.
entries.behaviour: Bits 3 to 1 are the port C bit number, bit 0 the value, bits 6 to 4 are ignored. The output latch always takes it and port C is redriven. In handshake modes a flag bit sets or clears that flag, and INTE or a flag change re-evaluates INTR (flag map: port C read).
